open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have sub_l : ∀ a b, (a ++ [h1]).Subset ((a ++ b) ++ [h1]) :=
    fun a b x h => match List.mem_append.mp h with
    | .inl ha => List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ ha)
    | .inr h1 => List.mem_append_right _ h1
  have sub_r : ∀ a b, (b ++ [h1]).Subset ((a ++ b) ++ [h1]) :=
    fun a b x h => match List.mem_append.mp h with
    | .inl hb => List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hb)
    | .inr h1 => List.mem_append_right _ h1
  have step : ∀ {a b c d : List _}, a.Subset (b ++ [h1]) → c.Subset (d ++ [h1]) → (a ++ c).Subset ((b ++ d) ++ [h1]) :=
    fun h1 h2 => List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans h1 (sub_l _ _)) (List.Subset.trans h2 (sub_r _ _))
  induction post
  case const | op | bvar => exact List.Subset.empty
  case fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact step ih1 ih2
  case quant trih eih => exact step trih eih
  case ite cih tih eih => exact step (step cih tih) eih
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    dsimp [substOld]
    split
    · split
      · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
      · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    · exact step ih1 ih2
